Grotesque

groh-TESK -- from an Italian word for a decorated cave or grotto. · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Grotesque is comically or repulsively ugly or distorted.

The carved gargoyle's grotesque face was designed to ward off evil spirits.

Worked Example

A wax figure left too close to a heat lamp slowly melts into a warped, lopsided version of itself, its features stretching into an unsettling new shape.

That distorted, unsettling ugliness is exactly what grotesque describes. Unlike 'plain,' which is simply unremarkable, grotesque is disturbing or bizarre to look at.

How Grotesque Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

bizarre

bizarre: strikingly odd or unusual

hideous

hideous: extremely ugly or repulsive

distorted

distorted: pulled or twisted out of its usual shape

Antonyms

graceful

graceful: having beauty in movement or form

elegant

elegant: pleasingly stylish and refined

How Strong Is It? — bizarre → grotesque → hideous

bizarre vs. grotesque

bizarre vs. grotesque: Bizarre is milder than grotesque -- bizarre just means strikingly strange, while grotesque specifically adds a distorted, often repulsive ugliness to that strangeness.

hideous vs. grotesque

hideous vs. grotesque: Hideous can feel even stronger than grotesque: grotesque often implies a strange, distorted quality, while hideous emphasizes sheer repulsiveness, whether or not anything is actually distorted.

Build the Word

The pieces

root — grott-

root — grott-: cave, grotto (Italian (grotta))

Put it together

Put it together: Grotesque comes from Italian grottesca, describing the strange, fantastical decorative art found painted inside ancient Roman grottoes, or caves. Grotesque, at its root, describes that same bizarre, distorted style -- the same root that gives us grotto.

Use the root in a new word: grotto

Use the root in a new word: grotto: Tourists paddled small boats deep into the glowing sea grotto carved into the cliffside.

Word Building

Word Choice

Grotesque can describe something frightening and ugly, as in horror films, or something absurdly exaggerated, as in grotesque humor or caricature.
